## File: facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-environments/gaia2-cli/core/gaia2_core/event_loop/processor.py

Prompts

```
['build an EventProcessor from a ScenarioLoader to run a Gaia2 scenario simulation', 'build turn trigger ConditionCheck events at turn boundaries for multi-turn Gaia2 scenarios', 'run the EventProcessor tick loop to drain scheduled events and return pending ENV actions', 'collect agent events for a specific turn index to evaluate with a judge', 'assign turn indices to scenario events using BFS over the dependency DAG']
```

Usage

```
{'build_event_processor_from_loader': 'build an EventProcessor from a ScenarioLoader to run a Gaia2 scenario simulation', 'build_turn_triggers': 'build turn trigger ConditionCheck events at turn boundaries for multi-turn Gaia2 scenarios', 'run_tick_loop': 'run the EventProcessor tick loop to drain scheduled events and return pending ENV actions', 'collect_turn_agent_events': 'collect agent events for a specific turn index to evaluate with a judge', 'assign_turn_indices': 'assign turn indices to scenario events using BFS over the dependency DAG'}
```
